pages.title: Advanced Furnace
pages.text: Nine slots: the four above take ingredients, the four below give products, and the slot on the left takes fuel.$(br2)It smelts in $(thing)four slots at once$(), burning fuel four times as fast as a normal furnace — which is to say it smelts four times as much.$(br2)It only accepts vanilla $(thing)smelting$() recipes.$(br2)While $(thing)a lit gas cooking stove sits directly below$() it needs no fuel and burns forever.

pages.title: Oven
pages.text: Right-click an Advanced Furnace with a $(thing)Baking Tray$() to convert it into an Oven (using one tray); the reverse works too — right-click the oven with a crowbar to get an Advanced Furnace back, along with the tray.$(br2)The oven $(thing)consumes four portions of ingredients at once$() and takes 10 seconds per product.$(br2)It also bakes $(thing)pizza$(): top a raw pizza and put it in.$(br2)A lit gas cooking stove below it likewise means no fuel.
